mechanism: Allopurinol may increase ceftazidime levels by inhibiting renal tubular secretion and can increase ampicillin/amoxicillin rash risk when combined with beta-lactams, though ceftazidime rash risk is lower than with aminopenicillins.
action: Monitor renal function and adjust ceftazidime dosing if necessary in patients on allopurinol; observe for hypersensitivity reactions; no dose adjustment typically required for ceftazidime.
